validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. A three-wave periodic projector and Fermi-occupation model Show a genuine rank-one nonlocal kernel and finite-temperature occupations in a three-wave periodic educational model. Assumptions, units and boundaries Authored rank-one periodic linear model and finite-N Helmholtz forces. No real metal/element pseudopotential/norm conservation/Hartree-XC/long MD claim. N=1.5 is a mean independent-particle Fermi occupation count, not an integer-N canonical many-body ensemble. Dimensionless G=-1,0,1,p=G+k,k=±.25 with equal.5weights,T=.05,mean electron countN=1.5 and spin factor2. No physical lattice-constant or metal mapping. Editorial clarification Authored linear3-wave Hamiltonian with independent-particle mean Fermi occupations, not an integer-particle canonical many-body ensemble. No self-consistent Hartree/XC, element-fitted norm-conserving PSP, real metal, general material or longMD validation. Adopted numerical method Solve3x3 Hermitian blocks, determine fixed-N Fermi occupations and differentiate Helmholtz free energy including entropy.
